prd: Beacon v1.4.9 在真实 BMTOP 项目 QA 验收中暴露出 P0 可信度问题：实现已经存在，Markdown QA 也已经存在，但机器闭环没有正确绑定 implementation evidence，也没有把 Markdown QA 编译为真实 AC matrix。
如果不先修复这一层，后续新增 `qa-evo-deep` 或 Better Harness 都会变成更多解释层，不能阻止真实项目继续出现假稳定信号。
AC-001: Implement 完成或受控导入后，必须写入 QA 可识别的 implementation evidence marker。
AC-002: Markdown QA 已存在且可解析时，machine AC matrix 必须从 Markdown QA 编译，不得静默 fallback 到占位 AC。
AC-003: QA runner 必须支持项目级 runner profile，首批至少覆盖 Go + UniApp 命令矩阵。
AC-004: QA outcome 必须区分 product/test failure 与 runner/environment/auth/evidence admission blocker。
user_story: As a Beacon operator validating a real project, I want implementation evidence, Markdown QA truth, project runner commands, and blocker taxonomy to stay aligned, so that QA and release do not produce false closure signals.

| AC-001 | implementation evidence | Implement completion or controlled `import-evidence` writes a QA-readable implementation evidence marker with feature, version, run/import id, source refs, changed files or service directories, summary ref, created_at, imported flag, and approved_by when imported. |

| AC-002 | markdown matrix | When Markdown QA has a parseable coverage matrix, `.machine/qa/<feature>.ac-test-matrix.json` preserves the original AC ID, TC ID, layer, command, assertion, and evidence path; parser failure blocks with diagnostics instead of fallback. |
| AC-003 | project runner | QA can resolve a Go + UniApp project runner profile with backend target tests, frontend type-check, miniapp build, and route check commands. |

| AC-004 | blocker taxonomy | QA distinguishes product_failed, test_failed, runner_admission_blocked, environment_blocked, auth_session_blocked, evidence_binding_missing, coverage_gap, and truth_projection_gap. |

decision_priority: Markdown QA truth beats generated fallback.
Explicit implementation evidence beats missing runtime state only after controlled import.
Project runner profile beats generic fallback command.
Environment blocker must not be collapsed into product failure.
Better Harness and `qa-evo-deep` cannot substitute P0 runtime closure.
